Quote: Life is like being at the dentist. You always think that the worst is still to come, and yet it is over already.
Author: Viktor E Frankl

Quote: Emotion, which is suffering, ceases to be suffering as soon as we form a clear and precise picture of it.
Author: Viktor E Frankl

Quote: He who has a why to live for can bear with almost any how,
Author: Viktor E Frankl

Quote: sometimes he does not even know what he wishes to do. Instead, he either wishes to do what other people do (conformism) or he does what other people wish him to do (totalitarianism).
Author: Viktor E Frankl

Quote: fear brings about that which one is afraid of, and that hyper-intention makes impossible what one wishes.
Author: Viktor E Frankl

Quote: a human being is not one in pursuit of happiness but rather in search of a reason to become happy,
Author: Viktor E Frankl

Quote: Live as if you were living for the second time and had acted as wrongly the first time as you are about to act now.
Author: Viktor E Frankl
